sentences.en: How can we best support learners to become balanced bilinguals?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能最好地支持学习者成为均衡的双语使用者？

sentences.en: Let's pray he turns out to be a fast learner.
sentences.zh: 希望他能成为一个学得快的学习者。

sentences.en: Why wouldn't more language learners request everyday vocabulary and phrases?
sentences.zh: 为什么更多的语言学习者不会要求获得日常词汇和短语呢？

senses.zh: 学习者, 学习驾车者, 学习驾驶员
